tableData:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tb_blog_category` (
  `lt_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `category_name` varchar(150) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `category_description` text COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci,
  `status` enum('isActive','isNotActive') COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT 'isActive',
  `show_on_menu` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `created_by` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_by` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`lt_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tb_blog_comment` (
  `lt_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `post_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `user_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `parent_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `body` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('pending','approved','spam','deleted') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'approved',
  `like_count` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`lt_id`),
  KEY `idx_post_id` (`post_id`),
  KEY `idx_parent_id` (`parent_id`),
  KEY `idx_user_id` (`user_id`),
  KEY `idx_post_status` (`post_id`,`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_comment_parent` FOREIGN KEY (`parent_id`) REFERENCES `tb_blog_comment` (`lt_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_comment_post` FOREIGN KEY (`post_id`) REFERENCES `tb_blog_post` (`lt_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=179066634040088 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tb_blog_comment_like` (
  `lt_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `user_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `comment_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`user_id`,`comment_id`),
  KEY `fk_cl_comment` (`comment_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_cl_comment` FOREIGN KEY (`comment_id`) REFERENCES `tb_blog_comment` (`lt_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tb_blog_media` (
  `lt_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `post_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `uploaded_by` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `filename` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `original_name` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `mime_type` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `file_size` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `storage_path` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `media_category` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `alt_text` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `caption` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`lt_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tb_blog_post` (
  `lt_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `author_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `category_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `slug` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `excerpt` text COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci,
  `content` longtext COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `seo_title` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `seo_description` text COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci,
  `reading_time` smallint(6) DEFAULT '1',
  `allow_comments` tinyint(1) DEFAULT '1',
  `status` enum('draft','pending','published','private','scheduled','archived') COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT 'draft',
  `published_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `fileSize` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `originalName` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `filename` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `co_authors` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `view_count` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `like_count` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `comment_count` int(10) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `show_on_menu` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `is_featured` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  PRIMARY KEY (`lt_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `slug` (`slug`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=26 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tb_blog_post_reaction` (
  `lt_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `user_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `post_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `reaction_type` enum('like','love','laugh','wow','sad','angry','celebrate','dislike') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`lt_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `user_id` (`user_id`,`post_id`),
  KEY `fk_reaction_post` (`post_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_reaction_post` FOREIGN KEY (`post_id`) REFERENCES `tb_blog_post` (`lt_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tb_blog_report` (
  `lt_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `post_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `user_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `reason` enum('spam','harassment','hate_speech','copyright','other') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `comments` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `status` enum('pending','reviewed','dismissed','action_taken') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`lt_id`),
  KEY `idx_post_id` (`post_id`),
  KEY `idx_status` (`status`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_report_post` FOREIGN KEY (`post_id`) REFERENCES `tb_blog_post` (`lt_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=179061877176644 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tb_blog_setting` (
  `lt_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL,
  `setting_key` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('isActive','isNotActive') COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'isActive',
  `setting_value` text COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`lt_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `setting_key` (`setting_key`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tb_blog_tag` (
  `lt_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `tag_name` varchar(80) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `tag_slug` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `tag_description` text COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci,
  `tag_color` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('isActive','isNotActive') COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT 'isActive',
  `created_by` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_by` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`lt_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `name` (`tag_name`),
  UNIQUE KEY `slug` (`tag_slug`),
  UNIQUE KEY `tag_name` (`tag_name`),
  UNIQUE KEY `tag_slug` (`tag_slug`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=182600000012357 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tb_blog_user` (
  `lt_id` bigint(20) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `fullname` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `username` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `avatar` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `bio` text COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci,
  `location` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `facebook` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `twitter` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `linkedin` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `user_id` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`lt_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `username` (`username`),
  UNIQUE KEY `email` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=179249183413045 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8 COLLATE=utf8_unicode_ci
